content: Rachel Morris, who holds qualifications as a DHP (Diploma in Hypnotherapy and Psychotherapy) and MCAP (Member of the Counselling and Psychotherapy Association), is a British psychotherapist and counsellor based in Manchester, UK. She has been featured as an expert on various television programs, including Little Angels and Say No to the Knife for BBC Three, Would Like to Meet, The Oprah Winfrey Show, Big Brother's Little Brother, and The Big Brother Psych Show. Additionally, she has appeared on BBC Radio 1's Sunday Surgery. Beyond her media appearances, she serves as a consultant for Cosmopolitan magazine and contributes to the Relationships section of the BBC website.
